items.text: Kokaru lokiareit loka airumit naka Nebukadenesar kiruja ŋesi airujasia; kiyaloŋoŋ kotauke, kikoleroto akekonyen,
Kosodi ekabaka aicorakin anyaraun imurwok, ka ikasupok, ka ikaroak, ka Ikaludean alimokin ekabaka airujasiake, Kolomasi do kobwaata kakonyen nuka ekabaka.
Kotema eka baka kes atiar, “Erujat eoŋ airujasit, kiyaloŋoŋ da ekatau ajenun airujasit.”
Kosodete Ikaludean atemar ekabaka kaIJajep naka. Asurian ebe, “Wu ekabaka, kobusi ikar kere: kolimok ikonikejaanakinak airujasit, ka sio da kitoduuni apolouke.”
Koboŋok ekabaka kotema Ikaludean atiar, “Alom akirot kamaka: arai mam yes itejenunete eoŋ airujasit ka apolouke da, kijepejepeo yes, ikusitogoi da eraunos amejei.
Konye do arai kitodutu airujasit ka apolouke, idumunete ainakineta ka iropito ka aibuses naepol da; asa kitodikinai eoŋ airujasit ka apolouke da.”
Kirucakis aboŋokin ebe, “Kolimok do eka baka ikekejaanakinak airujasit, kasodete isio aitodiar apolouke.”
Koboŋok ekabaka ebe, “Ajeni eut ebe ikotosi yesi aitumor naarai ianyut ebe alom akirot kamakaŋ.

Konye arai mam kitejenikinete eoŋ airujasit, ejai ekisil ediopet kanukus: naarai ipotu kitemokis akiro nukaisab ka nukaronok einer kakonyeneka, aitodol nailoeokinotor apakio: asa do kolimokinai eoŋ airujasit, kasodi eoŋ ajenun ebe ipedorete aitodiar apolouke.”

Kobonokis Ikaludean kakonyen nuka eka baka ebe, “Emamei da ituŋanan kakwap yenepedori aitodiar akirot naka ekabaka: naarai emamei ekabaka loepol ido lokapedor lolem inisit emurwon, arai ekasupon, arai Ekaludeat akirot naikoni nen.
Epagal akirot naitinaikinit ekabaka, kwabo emamei yenepedori aitodikin ekabaka, dimikito idekesio lumam iboiete kaluejaas awat.”
Kanuka ŋun kodedeniar ekabaka konyunyurikin noi, kicorak amudiar lukacoa kere luko Babulon.
Aso kolimoroi ekisil loka aiar lukacoa; aponi komoai Daniel ka lukaupake da aiar.
Kosodi Daniel aboŋokin kacoa kaiyapepera Ariok ekapolon loka ikedarak luka ekabaka, loalomarit aiar lukacoa luko Babulon;
Koboŋok kotema Ariok ekapolon loka eka baka ebe, “Kanukinyo kisuburikinia ekisil loebunit kama ejai ekabaka?” Kosodi Ariok aitejenun Daniel akirot.
Koloma Daniel, kilip ekabaka aseikin ŋes apak, tetere itodikini ekabaka apolou.
Kosodi Daniel alosit togoke, kitejenik ikepaup Kanania, ka Misael, ka Asaria akirot.
Tetere ilipete aitim naka Edeke loka akuj kanuka aiyeiyea kaŋin; kinyeis Daniel ka ikepaup amudiario nepepe ka lukacoa ice luko Babulon.
Kosodi kopukokinai Daniel aiyeiyea kaitapoet naka akuar. Kosodi Daniel aimal Edeke loka akui.

Aso koloma Daniel mama ejai Ariok, loabu ekabaka koseu amudiar lukacoa luko Babulon: abu kolot kotema ŋes kwanata atiar, “Sirikimudia lukacoa luko Babulon: kitolomarai eoŋ mama ejai eka baka, eoŋ da etodikini ekabaka apolou.”
Kosodi kisunya Ariok aitolomar Daniel mama ejai ekabaka, kotema ŋes kwanata ebe, “Adum eoŋ etuŋanan lokodwe Iuejoreunitai luka Yuda, itejenikini ŋesi ekabaka apolou.”
Koboŋok ekabaka kotema Daniel, ekekiror Beletesasar, atiar, “Ipedori tope ijo aitejenikin eoŋ airujasit naabu kaany, ka apolouke da?”
Koboŋok Daniel kakonyen nuka ekabaka ebe, “Mam epedorete lukacoa, ka ikasupok, ka imurwok, karaida ikadwarak aitodikin ekabaka nukaiyeiyea nuabu ekabaka kicorak:
konye ejai Edeke toma akuj, loepukori nukaiyeiyea, ido kitejenik ŋesi ekabaka Nebukadenesar nuejaunete kapaarasia nukoinaren, Akoniirujasit, ka aitapoeta nuka akoukon kaperitikon, kes nuta:
Wu ekabaka, apotu aomisio kopotu mama ijai ijo kaperitikon, nuka nuekotosi ajakut; ŋol da loepukori nukaiyeiyea kitejenik ijo nuekotosi ajakut.
Konye mam kapukokinitai eoŋ aiyeiyea na kanuka adiocoa nakijaar eoŋ adepar yenikajaran kere, konye tetere itejenikinio ekabaka apolouke, ido tetere ijenuni aomisio nukotaukon,
“Wu ekabaka, ibu kosesen, ido koany, aput nakos. Abu aput nin nakapedor, naimwekimwek aitelekar, kobwo kakonyenekon; eiponeke da loketasuro.
Aput ŋin korai akouke nakesabu loejok, aketorobu da ka akaninike nukepuesa, akekoik ka amurwosike nukaisinit,
akejeke nukasua, ka aicaketake da atutubet nakasuat ka atutubet nakelupe,
Ibu kosesen aitodol neatiakar amoru, komam akan etirorit, kocam aput aicaketake nukasua ka elupe, kobilibil kes,

Kobilibilunos da asuat, ka elupe, ka aisinit, ka epuesa, ka esabu da, koluoros kwape agugu nukopejal kamu; kokutar ekwam pit, komam kes edumunitos aibois: koluor amoru naabu kocam aput eronat lokos, kilelebun akwap kere.
“Ŋin ŋes airujasit; kilimori kwana do apolouke kakonyen nuka ekabaka.
Ŋo, wu ekabaka, irai ekabaka loka ikabakan, loabu Edeke loka akui koinak ajakanut, ka apedor, ka agogoŋ, ka aibuses.
Kama iboioto da idwe luka ituŋa kere, abu kokorak akanikon itian luka ais ka ikweny luka akui, koinak ijo ayait kes kere: irai ijo akou naka esabu.
Akaulokon kitupakin acejakanut namam eriakas kajo; ka ajakanut ace nakiwuniet naka aisinit naeyai rwaru akwap kere.
Egogoŋ ajakanut nakiwononet kwape kasuat: naarai ebilibilei asuat iboro kere, idecideci da: ido kwape kipicipicia asuat nul kere, ebilibilei ipicipici ŋin da.

Ido kwape kianyunia aicaketa ka ibokoro, atutubet naka elupe loka ekajean, atutubet da naka asuat, eraun ajakanut naetiakak; konye ejaun kotomake agogoŋ naka asuat, naarai ibu koany asuat inyalakina elupe lokenyadu.
Ido kwape keraatar ibokor luka akejen atutubet nakasuat, atutubet da nakelupe, ikwaikin nen ajakanut, atutubet naegogon, ka atutubet da naebilil.
Ido kwape kianyunia asuat inyalakina kelupe lokenyadu, inyalakin kwape kwaŋin aur naka ituŋa; konye mam imorianakinos, kwape mam inyalakinotor asuat kelupe.

Ido kapaarasia nuka ikabakan nul edakakini Edeke loka akui ajakanut namam emudiario ikar kere, karaida airumuke ajalakinio ituŋa ice; konye ebilibilei emudiari da ajakanuto nun kere, ido kojaenena ikar kere.

Ido naarai ibu koany amoru etiakun koronat komam akan etirorit, kobilibil asuat, ka aisinit, ka elupe, ka epuesa, ka esabu da; etejenu Edeke lokapolon ekabaka nuekotosi ajakut: erai airujasit nakabeit, etogogoŋi da apolouke.”
Kosodi ekabaka Nebukadenesar aibiror ebuburia, koma Daniel, kicorak ainakin asubanit ka lueur maa.
Koboŋok ekabaka kotema Daniel atiar, “Abeit Ekonideke ŋes erai Edeke loka idekesio, ka EJAKAIT loka ikabakan, ka ekapukoron nukaiyeiyea, naarai ipedo ijo apukor aiyeiyea nin.”
Kitopoloo do ekabaka Daniel, koinak ŋes ainakineta nuipu nuepolok, koinak ŋes ayait ebuku kere loko Babulon, kitarau da ŋes ekayaiton lokapolon loka lukacoa kere luko Babulon.
Kilip Daniel ekabaka, kitopol ŋesi Sadurak, ka Mesak, ka Abed-nego kotoma akiro nuka ebuku loko Babulon: konye kojaenena Daniel orute loka ekabaka.
